DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 雨が上がりましたね。散歩の経路についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The rain has stopped. Are you asking about a walking route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 土の道がぬかるんでいて、靴が滑りそうです。今日は乾いた道だけを歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 土がぬかるみ滑りそうなので乾いた道を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The dirt path is muddy and my shoes might slip. I'd like to walk only on dry paths today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the ground is muddy and slippery, so you'd like a dry path. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内図では舗装された道を確認できますが、雨のあとに乾いているかまでは図で判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The map shows paved paths, but it can't tell us whether they're dry after rain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 舗装でも水が残るのですね。今の路面の様子がわかる範囲で、短い散歩の候補を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 舗装でも残水があると理解し確認済み範囲で短い経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So even paved paths may have water left. Could you suggest a short walk based on what you know of the current surface conditions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that water can remain on pavement and ask for a short route within the confirmed area. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できる範囲をご案内します。水たまりや滑りやすい場所があれば、無理に通り抜けず引き返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll explain what we can confirm. If you encounter puddles or slippery spots, turn back rather than trying to push through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水たまりを避けて芝生へ入るのではなく、通れる道で歩きます。途中で座れる場所も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 芝生へそれず通れる道を選び座れる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll stay on passable paths instead of going onto the lawn to avoid puddles. I'd also like to check where I can sit along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose passable paths without straying onto the lawn and ask where you can sit. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ベンチの位置はこの印です。ただ、座面が濡れている場合もあるので、座る前に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: These marks show the benches. The seats may be wet, though, so check before sitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 濡れていたら座らず戻ります。この曲がり角から、今いる入口へ戻る道はどれでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 濡れた席には座らず戻り曲がり角から入口への道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If they're wet, I won't sit and will head back. Which path from this corner leads back to the entrance we're at now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll return without sitting on wet seats and ask for the way from the corner to the entrance. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内図の入口表示へつながる道をたどりましょう。現地の標識と合わないときは、先へ進まず現在地を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Follow the path that connects to the entrance symbol on the map. If it doesn't match the signs on site, stop and confirm your location before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口へ戻る道を図で覚えておきます。標識がわからなくなったら、来た道を確認して引き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 戻る道を図で確認し標識不明時は来た道を確かめ引き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll remember the return route from the map. If I can't understand the signs, I'll check the way I came and turn back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the return route on the map and say you'll retrace your way if the signs are unclear. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日は路面を見ながら、いつもよりゆっくり歩いてください。それでは、無理のない範囲でいってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Watch the path surface and walk more slowly than usual today. Enjoy your walk within a comfortable limit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符をお求めですか。目的地が決まっていれば、路線図で確認できますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you buying a ticket? If you know your destination, we can check the route map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に会いに行きますが、帰る時刻が未定です。最初から往復で買う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅時刻が未定で往復切符が必要か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm going to meet a friend, but I don't know when I'll return. Do I have to buy a round-trip ticket from the start?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a round-trip ticket is necessary when your return time is undecided. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 片道だけ買う方法もあります。目的地の駅名を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can also buy just one way. Could you tell me your destination station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人のメッセージには中央駅とあります。途中で別の路線に乗り換えるとも書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の指定した中央駅と乗換情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend's message says Chuo Station. It also says to transfer to another line on the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your friend's specified Chuo Station and the information about transferring. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ名前の駅を取り違えないよう、路線名も確かめましょう。メッセージに続きはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the line name too so we don't confuse stations with the same name. Is there more to the message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 続きには、私鉄の方の中央駅とあります。そこまで一枚で買えるのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 私鉄側の中央駅まで一枚で買えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It continues, “Chuo Station on the private railway.” I'd like to know whether I can buy one ticket all the way there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether one ticket can take you to Chuo Station on the private railway. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗換先まで買えるかは、路線と発売範囲を確認します。別に購入する場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the lines and ticket sales coverage to see whether we can sell a ticket beyond the transfer. Sometimes tickets must be bought separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別々になるなら、まず乗換駅までの片道を買いたいです。降りてから次の切符を買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別売りなら乗換駅まで買い現地で次を買えるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: If they're separate, I'd first like a one-way ticket to the transfer station. Can I buy the next ticket after getting off there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: If tickets are separate, choose one to the transfer station and ask whether you can buy the next one there. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗換駅の購入場所も調べてご案内します。帰りの切符は、予定が決まってから選んでかまいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll also look up where to buy at the transfer station and explain. You can choose your return ticket after your plans are decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、乗換駅までにします。購入前に、路線名と行き先をもう一度読み合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片道の路線名と行き先を購入前に確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll go as far as the transfer station. Before I buy, please read through the line name and destination with me once more.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask staff to confirm the one-way line name and destination before purchase. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。表示を確認してから購入を進めましょう。ご友人とのお出かけ、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Let's check the display before buying. Have a safe trip to meet your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの封筒についてのご相談でしょうか。通知も一緒に見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the envelope you brought? Please show me the notice too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この通知に返送するよう書いてありますが、折り目のところの日付が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知の折り目で返送日が判読できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This notice says to send a response back, but I can't read the date at the fold.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the fold in the notice makes the return date illegible. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 期限の部分ですね。差出元の部署名は下にあります。返信用の封筒も入っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's the deadline section. The sending department is listed below. Was a return envelope included too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、これです。ただ、通知の部署名と封筒の宛先が少し違って見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知部署と返信封筒の宛先の表記差を指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, this one. But the department name on the notice and the destination on the envelope look slightly different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the difference between the department on the notice and the return envelope's address. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここで別の手続きだと決めつけず、差出元に確認しましょう。中の回答用紙はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check with the sender rather than assume here that it's a different procedure. Do you have the response form inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 回答用紙も持ってきました。空欄のままですが、窓口で出せるのか、郵送だけなのか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未記入の回答用紙を示し窓口提出と郵送の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought that too. It's still blank, but I'd like to ask whether I can submit it at the counter or only by mail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the blank response form and ask whether counter submission or mailing is possible. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出方法と期限を担当者に確認します。通知にはご本人以外の情報もありますから、原本をそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the person in charge about the submission method and deadline. The notice includes information about people besides you, so keep the original intact with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。期限が迫っている場合は、今日相談したことも担当の方に伝えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限が近ければ本日相談した事実を担当者へ伝えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. If the deadline is close, could you also tell the person in charge that I came for advice today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask that today's consultation be reported to the person in charge if the deadline is near. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。間に合うかどうかは担当者の説明を聞いて、次の対応を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Let's hear their explanation of whether you can meet the deadline, then decide what to do next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部署名、提出方法、期限の三つをメモして帰りたいので、順番に説明してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部署名提出方法期限の三点を順に説明してもらいメモする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to note the department name, submission method, and deadline before leaving, so please explain those three in order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the department name, submission method, and deadline to be explained in order so you can take notes. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その三点を確認できる窓口へご案内します。封筒も忘れずにお持ちください。それでは、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take you to the counter that can confirm those three points. Don't forget your envelope. Please go ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。問診票をお渡ししますが、お書きになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit. I'll give you a medical questionnaire; are you able to fill it in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右手がしびれて、ペンをうまく持てません。口で説明してもいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右手のしびれでペンが持ちづらく口頭説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My right hand is numb and I can't hold a pen well. May I explain verbally?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say numbness in your right hand makes holding a pen difficult and ask to answer verbally. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: もちろん伺います。しびれはいつからですか。今も続いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Of course, we'll listen. When did the numbness start? Is it still continuing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝から続いています。仕事の途中で気になり、初めてこちらへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝から続くしびれに仕事中気づいて初診に来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's continued since this morning. I noticed it while working and came here for the first time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the numbness has continued since this morning, you noticed it at work, and this is your first visit. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の状態を確認するため、担当の看護師にも伝えます。受付に必要な確認書類は持っていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the nurse in charge so they can check your current condition. Have you brought the documents needed for registration?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ってきた書類はこのケースに入っています。使えるものを見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ケース内の受付書類を見て利用可能なものを確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The documents I brought are in this case. Could you look and see which can be used?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask staff to check which registration documents in your case can be used. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一つずつ確認します。問診の項目は、こちらで読み上げて回答を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check them one by one. We'll read the questionnaire items aloud and confirm your answers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 薬の名前を覚えていませんが、お薬手帳があります。それを見ながら答えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬名が不明なのでお薬手帳を見ながら回答したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't remember the medicine names, but I have my medication notebook. I'd like to answer while looking at it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you don't know the medicine names and want to answer using your medication notebook. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お薬手帳を一緒に確認しましょう。お話の途中で具合が変わったら、すぐ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the medication notebook together. If your condition changes while we're talking, tell us immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 承知しました。書いた内容に間違いがないか、最後に読み上げてもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問診内容を最後に読み上げて確認させてほしいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. It would help if you could read back what you've written at the end so I can check for mistakes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the questionnaire answers to be read back at the end for confirmation. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 回答の確認までお手伝いします。症状は看護師へ引き継ぎますので、ここでお待ちください。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll help through checking your answers. I'll pass your symptoms to the nurse, so please wait here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵を届けに来てくださったのですね。拾われた場所を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've brought in a key you found. May I ask where you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 川沿いの遊歩道で拾いました。橋の下ではなく、橋へ上がる階段の横です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 川沿いの橋へ上がる階段横で鍵を拾ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: On the riverside walking path. Not under the bridge, but beside the stairs leading up to it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you found the key beside the stairs up to the bridge along the river. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 階段のどちら側だったか、分かりますか。地図で指していただいてもかまいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know which side of the stairs? You can point it out on a map too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地図のこの場所です。植え込みの手前で、鍵が半分落ち葉に隠れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 植込み手前で落ち葉に隠れた位置を地図で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This place on the map. Just before the bushes, with the key half hidden under fallen leaves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the spot on the map before the bushes, where the key was hidden by leaves. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見つけたのは何時ごろでしたか。おおよその時刻でも大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: About what time did you find it? An approximate time is fine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 正確には覚えていません。直前に撮った写真が十一時二十分なので、その後すぐだったと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真の十一時二十分の直後と推定する理由を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't remember exactly. A photo I took just before shows 11:20, so I think it was right after that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain why you estimate finding it shortly after the photo time of 11:20. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのように記録します。拾った後は、ほかの方に渡さずお持ちになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record it that way. After finding it, did you bring it without handing it to anyone else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、この袋に入れて、そのまま持ってきました。鍵以外は何も拾っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋に入れ直接持参しほかの物は拾っていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I put it in this bag and brought it straight here. I didn't pick up anything besides the key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you brought it directly in a bag and didn't find any other items. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: これから品物の特徴と、届けてくださった方について確認します。説明で分からない部分は聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll now check the item's features and the details of the person handing it in. Ask if any part of the explanation is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手続きの説明を聞いてから、必要な欄を書きます。持ち主に戻せるよう、拾った位置も記録に残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後に記入し持ち主のため正確な位置を記録してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll fill in the necessary fields after hearing the procedure. Please record the exact place too so it can be returned to its owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll fill in the form after the explanation and ask for the precise location to be recorded for the owner. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所の説明も記録します。お届けいただき助かりました。受付後に控えをご案内しますので、お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll record your description of the location too. Thank you for bringing it. After acceptance we'll explain your receipt; take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居に伴う郵便のお手続きですね。お引越しされたのはご家族全員ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a postal procedure following a move. Did your whole family move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私だけです。両親は今の家に住み続けるので、家族全員の郵便が移らないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 両親は旧住所に残り自分の郵便だけ転送したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only me. My parents will keep living in the current house, so I don't want the whole family's mail redirected.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your parents remain at the old address and you want only your own mail forwarded. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転居される方のお名前を区別して申請する必要があります。現在お使いのお名前を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The application must distinguish the names of the people moving. Let's check the name you currently use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 普段はこの名前ですが、会社の郵便にはローマ字の表記もあります。両方を書いた方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社郵便のローマ字名も申請に書くべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I usually use this name, but mail from my company also uses a Roman-letter spelling. Should I write both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether to include the Roman-letter name used on company mail in the application too. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表記の扱いを確認してご案内します。旧住所と新住所の資料はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check how different spellings are handled and explain. Do you have documents for the old and new addresses?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両方メモしてあります。新しい部屋の表札がまだないのですが、それも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新旧住所のメモを示し新居に表札がまだないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written down both. The new room doesn't have a nameplate yet, and I'd like to ask about that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show notes of the old and new addresses and ask about the missing nameplate at your new home. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 部屋番号を含めて住所を確認しましょう。表札などの事情も担当へ伝えます。開始希望日は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's confirm the addresses including room numbers. I'll tell the person in charge about the nameplate situation too. Have you chosen a desired start date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週の月曜から希望します。ただ、その日から確実に届くとは限らないなら、会社にも新住所を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 月曜開始を希望し会社にも新住所を知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like next Monday. But if delivery isn't guaranteed from that day, I'll also tell my company my new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a Monday start and say you'll also notify your company of the new address. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開始までにかかる日数も確認してください。差出人への住所連絡は、別に進めていただくとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the number of days needed before it starts. It's a good idea to notify senders of the address separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両親の名前は対象に入れず、自分の表記だけ確認してから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両親を除き自分の名前の表記を確認して申請すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll exclude my parents' names and apply after confirming just the spellings of my own name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll apply after checking your own name spellings and excluding your parents. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは申請内容を一緒に確かめます。ご家族の分と混同しないよう進めましょう。本日はご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's check the application together. We'll proceed without confusing it with your family's mail. Thank you for asking today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更についてですね。通知が届いた封筒もお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about changing your address. Have you brought the envelope the notice came in too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。アプリで住所を変えたつもりなのに、この封筒は前の家へ届きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: アプリで変更したつもりなのに旧住所へ届いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought I'd changed my address in the app, but this envelope arrived at my old home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the app change was done but the letter arrived at the old address. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更操作をした日と、封筒の発行日を見比べましょう。操作後の画面は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the date you made the change with the envelope's issue date. Do you still have the screen shown after the operation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週の水曜に操作しました。画面には受付という文字があっただけで、完了の表示は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 水曜に操作し受付だけ見て完了は未確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did it last Wednesday. The screen only said “received”; I didn't see a completion message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you performed the operation Wednesday and saw receipt only, without confirming completion. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付と変更完了は同じとは限りません。本人確認をした上で、登録状況を担当者が調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Receipt doesn't always mean the address change is complete. After checking your identity, the person in charge will examine the registered details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。この通知が変更前に発送されたものか、今も古い住所のままなのか区別したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更前発送なのか登録未変更なのかを調べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I want to distinguish whether this notice was sent before the change or whether the old address is still registered now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to find out whether it was sent before the change or the registered address remains unchanged. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発送日と登録情報を確認しましょう。今後の送付先についても、希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the sending date and registration. We'll also ask where you want future mail sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今後は新住所へ送ってほしいです。古い家にはもう住んでいないので、そちらで受け取れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧住所では受け取れないため新住所への送付を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like it sent to my new address from now on. I no longer live at the old home, so I can't receive it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request future mail at the new address because you can't receive it at the old one. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認の結果、追加手続きが必要なら、その方法をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. If the check shows an additional procedure is needed, we'll explain how to do it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 完了を確認できる画面や書面も教えてください。次は受付という表示だけで終わったと思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 完了を確認できる画面または書面を教えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please also tell me which screen or document confirms completion. Next time I won't assume it's finished just because it says “received.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask which screen or document lets you confirm completion. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認方法も含めて担当窓口へ引き継ぎます。封筒をお手元にご用意ください。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass this to the responsible counter, including how to confirm it. Keep the envelope ready with you. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 同じ棚の二つの商品で迷われていますか。違いを確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you deciding between the two products on this shelf? Shall we check the differences?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰るまで二時間くらいかかります。片方は冷蔵と書いてあるので、持ち帰り方が心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅まで二時間かかり冷蔵商品の持ち帰りが心配と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It'll take about two hours to get home. One says refrigerated, so I'm worried about how to transport it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say getting home takes two hours and you're worried about transporting the refrigerated product. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品の保存方法は裏面にあります。こちらの常温の商品も、同じ欄を見て比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Storage instructions for this product are on the back. Let's compare the same section on this room-temperature product too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 常温の方には開封後は冷蔵と書いてあります。未開封なら表示の常温で保管するという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開封後冷蔵の表示と未開封常温の区別を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The room-temperature one says refrigerate after opening. Does that mean storing it at the labeled room temperature while unopened?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the difference between refrigeration after opening and room-temperature storage while unopened. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この表示では未開封と開封後で条件が分かれています。開けた後の注意も読んでおきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, this label gives different conditions before and after opening. Let's read the precautions after opening too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一度に食べきれないので、開けたらどう保管するか知りたいです。袋のまま閉じればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食べ残す予定で袋を閉じて保管できるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't finish it at once, so I want to know how to store it once opened. Can I just close the bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Since you'll have leftovers, ask whether closing the bag is enough for storage. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包装には「開封後は容器に移して冷蔵」とあります。食べきる時期の注意は、隣の文章にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The packaging says, “After opening, transfer to a container and refrigerate.” The next sentence gives precautions about when to finish it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この二つは原材料も違いますね。家にある料理に使いたいので、味付けの有無も見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理に使うため原材料と味付けの違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: These two have different ingredients too. I want to use it for a dish at home, so please also show me whether they're seasoned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the ingredients and seasoning differences because you'll use it for cooking. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原材料欄と商品説明を指して比べます。味付けがあるのはこちらです。内容量も違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll point out and compare the ingredient lists and descriptions. This one is seasoned. The quantities differ too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は常温の方を選びます。開封後は表示どおり容器に移して冷蔵することも覚えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 常温商品を選び開封後は容器へ移し冷蔵すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose the room-temperature one today. I'll remember to transfer it to a container and refrigerate after opening, as the label says.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the room-temperature product and say you'll transfer it to a container and refrigerate after opening. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示を確認して選んでいただけてよかったです。帰宅後も包装の注意をご覧ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad you could choose after checking the labels. Read the packaging precautions again at home too. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内のコース案内をご覧ですね。散歩用の道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the park's route guide. Are you looking for a walking path?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: しばらく運動していなかったので、今日は走らずに歩きます。距離が分かる道を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 運動から遠ざかっていたため走らず距離の分かる道を歩きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't exercised for a while, so today I'll walk rather than run. I'm looking for a path with a known distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you haven't exercised recently and want to walk rather than run on a path with a stated distance. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: コースごとの距離はこの表にあります。まず短い周回から選んではいかがでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This table gives each course's distance. Why not begin by choosing a short circuit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一周して出発点へ戻れるなら安心です。この点線も歩くコースですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出発点に戻れる周回を希望し点線の意味を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd feel reassured if one circuit takes me back to the starting point. Is this dotted line a walking course too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a circuit returning to the start and check what the dotted line means. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 点線は道ではなく区域の境目です。歩ける道は実線で示してあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The dotted line marks an area boundary, not a path. Paths you can walk on are shown as solid lines.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勘違いしていました。実線の短いコースの途中に、水分を飲んで休める場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実線の短いコースで水分補給できる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I misunderstood. On the short solid-line route, is there somewhere to stop and drink water?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a place to drink and rest on the short solid-line course. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 休憩場所の印はこちらです。人が多い広場へ入る道とは分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here's the rest-area symbol. It's separate from the path going into the busy plaza.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広場は避けたいです。周回を終えてまだ余裕があれば、同じ道をもう一度歩こうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 広場を避け余裕があれば同じ道を再周回する案を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to avoid the plaza. If I still feel okay after one circuit, I'm thinking of walking the same route again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll avoid the plaza and may do the same circuit again if you have energy left. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず一周して、そのときの疲れ方で決めましょう。現在地はこの案内板なので、ここを目印に戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do one circuit first, then decide based on how tired you feel. Your current location is this signboard, so you can use it as a landmark to return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内板を出発点にして、一周後に休みます。二周目へ進むかは、休んでから判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内板へ戻り休憩してから二周目を判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll start at the signboard and rest after one circuit. I'll decide on a second circuit after resting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll return to the signboard, rest, and then decide about a second circuit. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それなら道も覚えやすいですね。足元と周りの人に気をつけて、楽しい散歩を。では、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That should make the route easy to remember too. Watch your footing and the people around you, and enjoy your walk. Off you go, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 点検の表示をご覧になっていますね。この先へ進む前に、ご用件を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the inspection notice. Before you go further, may I ask where you're going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベビーカーで改札へ行きたいのですが、このエレベーターは今使えないということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベビーカーで改札へ行くため点検中のエレベーターが使えないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to reach the ticket gates with a stroller. Does this mean the elevator can't be used now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the elevator under inspection is unavailable because you need to reach the gates with a stroller. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示上は点検中です。運転の状況を確認しますので、乗り込まずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The notice says it's under inspection. I'll check its operating status, so please wait without entering it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもが寝ているので、できればベビーカーをたたまずに移動したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子どもが寝ているのでベビーカーを畳まず移動したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. My child is asleep, so if possible I'd like to move without folding the stroller.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your child is asleep and you'd like to move without folding the stroller. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の段差の少ない経路が利用できるか調べます。どちらの改札へ向かいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check whether another route with few steps is available. Which gates are you heading to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連れが待っている北側の改札です。反対側へ出ると合流できないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連れが北側改札で待ち反対側では合流困難と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The north gates, where my companion is waiting. If I go out the opposite side, we might not be able to meet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your companion is at the north gates and meeting may be difficult on the opposite side. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 北側へ通じる経路として確認します。お連れの方へ、少し待つことを知らせられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check for a route to the north side. Can you let your companion know you'll be waiting a little?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話できます。移動方法を確認中だと伝えるので、待ち合わせ場所は変えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連れに電話で待つよう伝えるので合流場所を変えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can call. I'll say we're checking how to get there, so please don't change the meeting place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll call your companion to wait and won't change the meeting point. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。階段で持ち上げる方法を先に選ばず、担当係員と安全な移動方法を相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Rather than first choosing to lift it on stairs, let's discuss safe ways to move with the responsible staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子どもを乗せたまま持ち上げるのは避けたいです。利用できる通路が分かるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子どもを乗せた持ち上げを避け利用可能通路の確認まで待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to avoid lifting it with my child still inside. I'll wait until we know which passage can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll avoid lifting the occupied stroller and wait until an available passage is confirmed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは担当へ連絡します。この広い場所でお待ちください。合流まで無理をせず、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll contact the person in charge. Wait in this spacious area. Don't push yourself before meeting up, and take care.
